card.title: The Gatekeeper
card.instruction: Use expertise and standards to decide who is qualified to judge, participate, or proceed.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Before joining our cheese panel, identify this rind.

before.speaker: B
before.text: I just came to eat cheese.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Consumption is not qualification.

before.speaker: B
before.text: Can I ask why?

before.speaker: A
before.text: After the rind test. Questions shape the panel too.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Before joining our cheese panel, identify this rind.

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I just came to eat cheese.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Then identify it for the tasting queue. Judging requires the county certificate.

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I have that certificate. I teach the county course.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Wonderful. Before you examine our cheese, let me examine your syllabus.

mechanism: A uses subject expertise and qualifying standards to control participation, then subjects an apparent expert to a further standard.
confusableConcept: Arbitrary obstruction or private veto.
distinguishingEvidence: A1 names a rind-identification test; revised A3 and A5 make access depend on credentials and curriculum rather than A's unexplained consent.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requires rind identification for panel membership; A5 extends that qualification requirement to questions.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 rejects B2's eating motive as a qualification; A5 answers B4's request to ask why, although abstractly.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants cheese rather than membership; B4's generic question supplies little additional pressure.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds questions to the admission restriction but leaves the original rind test unchanged.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a cheese panel and an identifiable rind; B2 makes B's immediate appetite playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Consumption is not qualification' is economical; A5's 'Questions shape the panel' is more explanatory.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 separates tasting eligibility from certified judging; A5 subjects even the course teacher's syllabus to A's standards.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's wish to eat produces A3's tasting queue; B4's teaching credential produces A5's syllabus inspection. A5 slightly assumes B now wants to examine the cheese.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants simple access to cheese, then B4 reveals expertise that should remove A's barrier and instead relocates it.

heightening.evidence: B4 establishes B as the certifier; A5 escalates from checking a participant to judging the certification curriculum.

specificity.evidence: A1's cheese panel and rind test are immediately playable; A3's tasting queue adds a slightly elaborate institutional distinction.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'examine our cheese' versus 'examine your syllabus' earns its reversal through B4's credential, although A3 is comparatively explanatory.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 distinguishes eating from judging; A3 creates an eating qualification and reserves certification for judges.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 teaches the qualifying course, so A5 moves the qualification test up to the syllabus.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 use specialist knowledge and standards to control participation.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes the authority behind the credential another applicant for A's approval.

writerReservation: A5 can sound knowingly evasive unless A sincerely believes inspecting the syllabus protects standards.
reviewerReservation: Minor shift from B wanting to eat to A treating B as an examiner. No rewrite needed for an internal pass.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's distinction between a diseased leaf and a blurry one earns its joke directly from B4's phone proposal.

hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 makes B a phone carrier rather than a judge; A5 invents a qualification relevant to that narrower role.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 consistently use expertise to decide who may participate or proceed.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 preserves the helpful remote arrangement while placing its implementation behind another competence test.

card.title: Rightful Place
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the rightful holder of your role and treat any demand for proof as an insult.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Why is my name on the waiting list for my own table?

before.speaker: B
before.text: Everyone has to book.

before.speaker: A
before.text: People seeking a table book. I have a table.

before.speaker: B
before.text: It's occupied.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Then those people are borrowing my problem.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Why is someone sitting in my chair at the founders' dinner?

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: He's a sponsor. Have you brought your founder's invitation?

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: You need an envelope to establish that I founded this place?

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I know you did. I'll bring another chair.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: For him, thank you. Put mine back at the head.

mechanism: A assumes the founder's place already belongs to them and treats documentary verification as an affront.
confusableConcept: General entitlement to preferential service.
distinguishingEvidence: Revised A1 identifies the founder's place, A3 takes offense at the invitation requirement, and A5 accepts help only on terms preserving that place.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims 'my own table,' but B2 requests booking rather than proof of a role, and A5 expresses no clear insult.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 distinguishes possession from B2's booking requirement; A5 responds to B4's occupants, though 'borrowing my problem' is unclear.

relationship.evidence: B2 enforces a universal booking rule and B4 reports occupancy, but neither clarifies A's relationship to the venue.

heightening.evidence: A5 maintains ownership language without specifying what the occupants must now do.

specificity.evidence: A1 gives a waiting list and table but leaves whether A is owner, regular customer or host unresolved.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'People seeking a table book' is concise; A5's borrowing metaphor obscures the practical move.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 treats producing a founder's invitation as insulting; A5 assumes the founder's rightful seat remains at the head.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 requests an invitation, prompting A3's offended envelope question; B4 offers another chair, which A5 allocates to the sponsor.

relationship.evidence: B2 manages a sponsor's seating and admission, then B4 acknowledges A's status and offers a practical accommodation.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4's additional chair into displacement of the sponsor and restoration of the head seat.

specificity.evidence: A1's occupied chair at the founders' dinner and B2's sponsor identify a concrete social problem immediately.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'For him, thank you' economically redirects B4's helpful solution while maintaining A's sincere entitlement.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks for documentary proof of founder status; A3 objects that an envelope should not establish A's identity.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 supplies a spare-chair solution; A5 assigns the spare to the sponsor and specifies restoration of A's seat.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 supplies the insult at requested proof, while A1 and A5 enact unquestioned rightful occupancy.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 uses accommodation to secure precedence, leaving B free to respond.

writerReservation: A's historical claim is accepted within the fiction; the comic behavior is the inflexible claim to seating precedence.
reviewerReservation: A5's escalation is modest but precise. No rewrite needed.

card.title: Rightful Place

before.text: I've put my nameplate on the committee chair.

before.speaker: B

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Put her on speaker. Once she's confirmed me, I'll ask her to minute your apology.

distinguishingEvidence: A1 begins chairing rather than seeking support; A3 takes the proof request personally, and A5 uses B4's verification call to demand an apology.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 physically claims the committee chair; A3 assumes legitimacy and A5 explicitly finds nomination insulting.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 recasts B2's election as confirmation; A5 answers B4's nomination requirement with the existing nameplate.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 uphold the committee's selection procedure, forcing A to reinterpret two distinct prerequisites.

heightening.evidence: A5 promotes A1's nameplate from a possession marker into sufficient evidence of nomination.

specificity.evidence: A1's nameplate and committee chair make the claim visible through speech; B4 supplies a concrete procedural obstacle.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'The nameplate already has' economically converts the established prop into A's response.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 occupies the chair without hesitation; A3 treats verification as an affront; A5 demands an official apology for it.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's result-sheet request causes A3's offended response. B4's secretary call supplies both the witness and minute-taker for A5.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a credible procedural need to verify the chair, and B4 offers an alternative route that A turns against B.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates A3's personal indignation into a demand that the apology enter the committee record.

specificity.evidence: A1's allotment committee nameplate and B2's result sheet establish an immediately playable meeting dispute.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'minute your apology' compresses the role claim and injured dignity into a consequence enabled by B4.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: A3 explicitly objects to B2's demand to prove entitlement to chair the meeting.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 introduces the secretary call; A5 requests speakerphone and makes that secretary the prospective recorder of B's apology.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A assumes rightful possession in A1 and interprets ordinary verification as an insult in A3 and A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 converts confirmation of authority into a proposed public remedy for questioning it; neither confirmation nor apology is forced to occur.

writerReservation: A5 is more affronted than affectionate. The secretary's actual answer remains open, so the scene does not establish that A's entitlement is valid.
reviewerReservation: A3 states the affront quite directly, and B's personal relationship to A remains thin. No rewrite needed.

card.title: The Crown Must Pass
card.instruction: Treat another person as your likely successor. Prepare them to lead, then reclaim authority whenever their independence makes your influence feel temporary.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Here's the café key. Your first day in charge. I'll watch quietly.

before.speaker: B
before.text: I'm changing the opening hours.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Run the quiet decisions past me first.

before.speaker: B
before.text: You said I was in charge.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Yes. I'm here to help you resemble it.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Here's the café key. Your first day in charge. I'll watch quietly.

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I'm opening an hour later. You won't have to come in.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Check timetable changes with me first. Regulars need continuity.

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I'll explain it to them myself.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Good practice. I'll stand beside you and handle any questions about the hours.

mechanism: A prepares a successor to lead but restores personal authority when that successor's independence would make A unnecessary.
confusableConcept: Ordinary micromanagement.
distinguishingEvidence: A1 explicitly hands over leadership; B2 removes A's need to attend, causing A3's approval requirement and A5's reclaimed public voice.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 hands over the café key and A3 reclaims approval after B2 changes hours; A5 reduces leadership to resemblance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's changed hours prompt A3's consultation rule; B4's reminder prompts A5's reinterpretation of being in charge.

relationship.evidence: B2 acts as a successor and B4 invokes A's promise, exposing the tension between handoff and control.

heightening.evidence: A5 comments on the successor's appearance of authority rather than taking a further concrete decision back.

specificity.evidence: A1's café key and B2's opening hours establish a playable business handover.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'help you resemble it' is compact, but makes A unusually explicit about undermining the handover.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 hands over the café key; B2 removes the need for A's presence; A3 and A5 reclaim approval and public authority under mentoring language.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 changes opening hours, prompting A3's timetable approval rule; B4 offers to explain personally, prompting A5's supervised explanation.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to exercise ownership and release A from attendance; B4 asserts responsibility for regulars, giving A two distinct independence threats.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from approving hours privately to standing beside B and answering the very questions B intended to handle.

specificity.evidence: A1's key handover and B2's later opening make the succession concrete; A3 identifies regular customers affected by the change.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Good practice' recasts B4's independent responsibility as a supervised exercise with no detached joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 changes the timetable and makes A's attendance unnecessary; A3 imposes prior consultation about timetable changes.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 will explain the change independently; A5 inserts A beside B and takes control of questions.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The key handover, promise to watch, and subsequent reclamation of control enact both halves of the succession instruction.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes the successor's public leadership another occasion for the predecessor to lead.

writerReservation: The final intervention is small in scale, but clearly takes the successor's customer-facing authority back.
reviewerReservation: The escalation stays small and plausible; its force depends on sincere mentoring delivery. No rewrite needed.

card.title: The Crown Must Pass

before.text: Take my chair, deputy. Lead the meeting.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends A3's procedural control into the successor's training and treatment of the former chair.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves beyond A3's verbal veto to reclaiming the actual review process beside the deputy.

hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: Because B4 has already redirected staff submissions, A5 asks for a follow-up announcement restoring A's final review.

hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns reinstated authority into compulsory instruction for the successor, leaving B free to resist.
